prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a one-storey house in a stone-and-plaster harbour town on a windy northern coast. blue-grey slate roof with overlapping slates and a ridge red-brown brick walls with stone corners. Windows have small panes glowing warm amber from inside (the only light). The whole image is 208 x 192 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: Edit the user-provided layout guide into ONE isolated building sprite. Treat the attached guide as a STRICT pixel-accurate registration template, not a loose inspiration: preserve the exact canvas proportions (208 x 192 art pixels), building exterior footprint, horizontal roof/front-wall boundaries, and the exact positions and dimensions of BOTH amber window rectangles and the dark-brown ground-level walk-through door wherever shown in the full reference. Do not move, shrink, replace, or hide the door; maintain a real rectangular door opening at the ground. Preserve the 3/4 top-down JRPG view: top block is roof seen from above; lower block is straight-on front wall, NOT a perspective side view. Northern-coast harbour-town one-storey home, overlapping blue-grey slate roof with modest ridge, subtle weathering in neatly grouped slate clusters, brick red-brown facade with worn plaster patches and clearly outlined stone quoins at corners. Windows are warm amber interiors with tiny clear square panes and dark framing, their warm glow confined to panes only. Subtle roof eaves and lintels; chimney only if it fits empty upper margin without changing footprint. Premium hand-placed modern hi-bit pixel art with perfectly hard uniform square pixels (each artwork pixel becomes an exact 7x7 square in a 1456x1344 display), tidy shaped clusters 3-10 art pixels, 4–6 discrete earthy shades per material, cool purplish/red saturated shadows and warm-yellow highlights. Calm evenly lit overcast evening, NO cast shadows or night effect or lamp pools. Replace magenta with actual full alpha transparency; no floor, no ground, no drop shadow, no text, no people. Sharp pixel edges only, no blur, antialiasing, noise, checkerboard dithering or photoreal texture.
